title: OpenText World 2026: What’s in it for the energy and resources industry?
summary: OpenText World 2026 has energy and resources covered! Join us for sessions, breakouts, advisory boards, and forums tailored to the industry.
body_markdown:
Companies in the energy and resources industry are faced with significant challenges, including how to drive asset reliability, improve safety, increase operational efficiency, maintain compliance, and prepare for an AI-powered future?


[OpenText World 2026](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/summary-1?_gl=1*hsbl23*_gcl_au*NDUxOTgxMjYuMTc4NzY2NjE1Mg..*_ga*MTAzNTY3NTQ4Ni4xNzg3NjY2MTUy*_ga_8LWPJ50ZXY*czE3ODgyNzczNzkkbzYkZzEkdDE3ODgyOTAxMDIkajI3JGwwJGgxMTI4MDczNDgx) in Orlando, October 19–22, is the place to find answers to these questions and more. The event’s energy and resources focus—including speaker sessions, breakouts, advisory boards, and forums—offers insight and advice about what’s on your mind today and what to think about for tomorrow.


Phil Schwarz, OpenText Energy and Resources Senior Industry Strategist, talks about what’s in store at OpenText 2026.


New to this year’s conference is the **Industry Advisory Board** for energy and resources. This focused gathering brings together senior industry leaders to discuss trends, challenges, and innovation opportunities. Participation is open to interested attendees and subject to approval to ensure a curated peer-to-peer experience. Find more information[here](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:b0383cbf-303c-4682-8546-a9e6973ac530) .


Join us for the **Energy and Resources Industry Forum** (Wednesday, 11:00 a.m.) to find out how peers are transforming asset information management, automating workflows, eliminating information silos, and creating trusted information foundations. At the forum, you’ll also hear from **John Villali, Research Director for IDC Energy Insights** , who will offer his perspectives on digital strategies for the energy and resources industry.


The conference also offers use cases, client success stories, how-to sessions, product roadmaps, round tables, and more. Here are just a few with an energy and resources lens that you won’t want to miss:


[How a leading gas and electric company turns their trusted content into AI-powered operational intelligence](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=1a657bfa-7a0b-464f-aa3e-e31c12244005&shareLink=true)


Wednesday, 1:45 p.m.


Learn how OpenText™ Documentum™ Content Management and OpenText™ Content Aviator™ transform vast amounts of enterprise content into actionable business insight. You’ll hear real-world examples, including from a large gas and electric company, that demonstrate how trusted, governed content becomes the fuel that powers AI-driven decision-making.


[Energy and resources industry client connect](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=99936a8f-bef6-4fdc-bef0-840bdc78223f&shareLink=true)


Thursday, 9:00 a.m.


Connect with peers from across the energy value chain and explore what AI can really do. Get a candid look at what it takes to scale AI across grids, assets, and markets.


[From capital projects to asset operations: Putting engineering information to work](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=b3b47941-26ec-4905-931a-4551d8391711&shareLink=true)


Thursday, 11:15 a.m.


Follow the information journey from project setup and design review through contractor collaboration, document exchange, approvals, and final handover. Learn how OpenText solutions can create a single source of truth, standardize project structures, automate document distribution and review, and use AI to streamline transmittal processing and identify incomplete or non-compliant documentation.
